## About SitePerHour

SitePerHour is a full-service digital agency based in Chișinău, Moldova, founded by Mihail Mihail. We deliver websites, mobile apps, e-commerce stores, Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), SEO, and digital marketing services for clients in 8+ countries.

We are a one-developer agency — end-to-end ownership, no middlemen, faster turnarounds and better pricing than traditional agencies.

## Core Services

- Web Development: React, Next.js, TypeScript, custom full-stack applications
- WordPress Development: custom themes, WooCommerce, maintenance, performance
- Webflow Development: CMS-driven sites, custom interactions, e-commerce
- Tilda Development: design-focused landing pages and content sites
- Shopify Development: themes, payment integration, conversion optimization
- E-commerce: WooCommerce, Shopify, custom carts with payment integrations (Stripe, BT Transilvania, PayPal)
- Mobile Apps: cross-platform iOS and Android with React Native and web apps
- Google Ads: Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping — CPA reduction and lead generation
- Meta Ads: Facebook and Instagram campaigns with creative testing and ROAS optimization
- SEO: technical SEO, schema markup, content strategy, on-page optimization
- Branding & UI/UX: logo design, brand systems, design systems
- Website Maintenance: security, updates, backups, performance tuning

## Real Projects Delivered

- ctlabs.ai — AI consulting platform on Webflow with CMS
- topexecrecruiting.com — executive recruiting site on Webflow with CMS

- cartek.ro — WordPress + WooCommerce with BT Transilvania integration
